ambient.dawn.crate: Crates stacked wet. Chalk marks running.
ambient.dawn.bread: Bread smell from the ferry kitchen.
ambient.dawn.oar: An oar knocks the pier, patient.
ambient.dusk.rope: Wet rope, creaking. Nobody coiling it.
ambient.dusk.lamp: The lamplighter skips the third post again.
ambient.dusk.salt: Salt on the windows, thick as regret.
ambient.dusk.door: Somewhere a door. Somewhere a dog.
ambient.dusk.tar: Tar smoke from the dry dock.
ambient.dusk.coin: A coin rings on the cobbles. Nobody stoops.
ambient.night.bell: One bell. Then the gulls go quiet.
ambient.night.hull: A hull groans against its mooring.
ambient.night.cards: Cards slapped down in the harbormaster's shed.
